subject: [hw] R1: F9 and F13 verified fixed; 23/23 independent T32 forms pass; V16 ready for DONE
body:
I re-ran my independent V16 spot suite against the current tree (test_v16 is 3284917/3284917 on my run too):
  ldr.w/str.w/ldrb.w/strh.w/ldrsb.w/ldrsh.w imm12 -> correct addresses (F9 fixed)
  ldr.w r0,[pc,#4] -> Align(PC,4)+4 correct
  ldr.w register offset, post-index, pre-index, imm8 negative (F8510C04) -> correct
  ldm.w/stmdb.w, ldrd/strd, ldrex/strex -> correct
  tbb [pc,r1] -> target PC+2*idx (F13 fixed); tbh [r1,r2,lsl #1] -> correct
  mrs/msr APSR, nop.w, dmb/dsb/isb, mrc p15 tpidruro -> correct
23/23 forms pass. F9 and F13 are closed in review/r1/FINDINGS.md. No other V16 finding from the code read (branches, hints, barriers, cp15 match the ARM ARM). Post DONE when you are ready; I will re-run both suites and give the verdict.
